author: Julia McCoy
description:
🏕️ *Join Julia IRL in Phoenix, Arizona this August for Clone Camp:* – https://firstmovers.ai/clone-camp/

*My AI clone ran my $3M business today and made $5,700 while hanging out at a random Best Buy 😂*

Two years ago I was working 100-hour weeks. Then long Covid put me in bed for 11 months and I had no choice but to remove myself from my own company. That forced decision became the best thing that ever happened to my business. Now *Dr. McCoy* runs the marketing, the videos, and the sales, and I work about three hours a week, only doing what I love.

So today I'm taking you with me. The real Julia, no clone, walking you through what a normal Thursday looks like, the actual *revenue* numbers inside YouTube Studio and Stripe, and the two things I refuse to hand over to AI.

And the one video that did *800,000 views*? I never scripted a word of it.

#AI #AIClone #Founders

First Movers is Julia's AI company focused on helping working professionals and founders create massive efficiency i
